comment: Curome de Paix delivered 150 pairs of S3 steel-toe work boots and heavy-duty 100% cotton coveralls to our base in Trans-Amadi, Port Harcourt in under 48 hours. Stitching quality is top-notch, exactly conforming to offshore rig regulations.

The interactive 360 viewer on the site allowed our safety team to inspect the ratchet helmet harness and anti-scratch ballistic glasses before approving the purchase order. Their office off NTA Road handled our custom chest embroidery with high precision.

We needed emergency shut-down gear dispatched to Bonny Island via Port Harcourt jetty. Their WhatsApp response desk was active immediately and we received proforma invoices within 30 minutes. 5 stars for dependability!

Solid industrial workwear supplier in Port Harcourt. Material durability holds up exceptionally well under heavy mud and petrochemical conditions. Looking forward to expanding our annual supply contract.
